Ringtones

Güven Phone Help Guide, version 2.0.22

Open Ringtone in Settings. The top of the screen shows the Current ringtone.

The Güven Phone ringtones list has eight sounds. Listen with Preview and stop with Stop. Tapping a sound (double-tapping with a screen reader) makes it your phone’s ringtone.

On the first choice you are asked for permission to modify system settings. Tap Open permission screen, turn the permission on in the page that opens and come back; your chosen sound is applied.

System ringtones opens Android’s own picker, which also has the Silent option.

To give a contact its own ringtone, choose Custom ringtone in the contact’s details.
